risks.note: The Company's commercial revenue is substantially dependent on a single asset - Embassy Zenith. Any material deterioration in occupancy, tenant credit quality or rental reversion at this asset could have a disproportionate impact on financial performance.

The revenue base is concentrated in Bengaluru, making it sensitive to local market conditions. BRSR discloses operations in a single state (Karnataka), exports of NIL as a percentage of turnover, and business-to-business customers only, with plants limited to wind turbine generators in Gadag and Bellary districts and the Zenith building at Sankey.
risks.risk: Geographic and single-market concentration in Bengaluru / Karnataka

risks.note: The real estate sector operates under a multi-layered regulatory framework spanning central, state and local authorities. Delays in project clearances or changes in land use regulations can impact development timelines and project viability, and RERA compliance requirements continue to evolve across states.
A slowdown in India's economic growth, rising interest rates or tightening liquidity conditions could dampen commercial office demand, reduce new leasing activity and affect home buyer affordability.
risks.risk: General economic conditions, interest rates and liquidity

risks.note: Development activity is exposed to volatility in construction material prices (particularly steel and cement), labour availability and logistics costs. Cost overruns can compress project margins, particularly for mid-scale developers with limited procurement leverage.

The windmill segment is subject to variability in wind resource availability and to DISCOM-related exposure; the Company's electricity offtake is concentrated in GESCOM and HESCOM. (The routed text is truncated mid-sentence, so the full description of this risk is not available.)
